note: Eval set for the haiku tier -- the keywords that localmodel/enforce-hook.js HARD-DENIES to a free local model. Those tasks run unsupervised with no human in the loop, so they are the only routing decisions where being wrong is silent and automatic. That makes them the highest-value thing to measure first. The seven mechanical-edit keywords (rename/typo/docstring/commit message/boilerplate/reformat/lint fix) were added to that tier on 2026-08-30 on judgment alone, with zero supporting evidence -- this set exists first and foremost to check whether that change was safe.
